members.question: Will NVIDIA commence Vera Rubin production shipments by December 31, 2026?

evidence.quote: We shipped our first Vera Rubin samples to customers earlier this week, and we remain on track to commence production shipments in the second half of the year.
This cloud will use the NVIDIA ® DSX™ platform and deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin accelerated computing powered by SK hynix HBM4, with the first AI factory planned to come online in 2027.
Nvidia’s latest generation of AI chips, the Nvidia Rubin GPUs, expected to ship later this year , may face supply delays amid ongoing geopolitical pressures and supply chain constraints.

members.question: Will the first SK Telecom AI factory described in the SK Group–NVIDIA partnership come online by December 31, 2027?

evidence.quote: This cloud will use the NVIDIA ® DSX™ platform and deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin accelerated computing powered by SK hynix HBM4, with the first AI factory planned to come online in 2027.
